name: vhdl
description: VHDL/FPGA development: design, RTL implementation, VUnit testing, debugging, synthesis and timing closure, and documentation. VUnit, synthesis, waveforms, Vivado design queries and a VHDL file index with exact lookups (vhdl_ls) go through the bundled vhdl-tools command-line tool, and a Read hook serves that index for large VHDL files; corvidex-mcp is optional.
